headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk analysis to provide up-to-date security insights. Leverage AI-driven scanning for potential vulnerabilities in npm and PyPI packages, including binding.gyp command expansions. Implement a dynamic update mechanism to ensure lockfile integrity.
actions: Integrate an AI-driven scanner from projects like dsh-superagent-prototype (18050) to continuously analyze dependencies for security risks.
